verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own docs cover sending a campaign through the Marketing API, with RSS campaigns sending on a schedule and others sending immediately. Campaign creation and email design are claimed, and audiences and segmentation exist. However, the evidence never explicitly shows choosing an audience for a campaign or scheduling a regular one-off campaign. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduling a standard campaign for a future time, explicit audience/segment selection when building a campaign, in-depth documentation of the compose workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of the full loop.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop

citations.quote: Send a Mailchimp campaign. For RSS Campaigns, the campaign will send according to its schedule. All other campaigns will send immediately.
